title: Misconception
description: First-class Misconception entity with content-hash ID (REC-LNK-02). Replaces the earlier unstable chunk-position-based misconception_id format.

id.description: Content-hash misconception ID: sha256(misconception_text + '|' + correction_text)[:16]. Stable across runs when text is unchanged.

concept_id.description: Optional typed link to the concept this misconception targets. misconception_rich wires it from the block's grounded concept_tags / domain vocabulary (named-concept link).

named_concept.description: misconception_rich: optional surface form of the named subject-specific faulty model this misconception targets. Grounded in the block's own concept_tags / domain vocabulary (anti-fabrication: absent when none resolves).

productive_failure.description: misconception_rich: optional predict -> reveal -> reconcile productive-failure scaffold. Additive; legacy {misconception, correction} records validate unchanged.

predict.description: The predict-then-reveal prompt asked BEFORE the correction.

reconcile.description: The reconcile step: why the named faulty model fails.

lo_id.description: Optional typed link to the LO this misconception threatens.
